chunks: That is because they came to believe, and then renounced (their faith). So their hearts were sealed; and now they do not understand.
ai.seo_question: Why are the hearts of hypocrites sealed according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the transition from active faith to entrenched disbelief, where the 'sealing' of the heart is viewed as a divine consequence of their own choices rather than mere predestination. This spiritual hardening renders them incapable of grasping deeper truths, a concept often linked to the 'seal' mentioned in Surah Al-Baqarah. The verse underscores the fragility of faith when it is not accompanied by consistent practice and sincerity.
